source.mod: ACWII (Napoleon: Total War American Civil War mod)

rights.licence_basis: owner-reported verbal permission from the mod author, 2026-11-11; no written text on file
rights.credit: ACWII mod by ACW_Primergy and team (used with the author's permission)
rights.scope_note: the mod author can license only files he made; every file is decided by evidence, unclear means excluded

codes.E1-SVN: Subversion record names ACW_Primergy and the md5 of the file equals the committed md5
codes.NO-SVN: no Subversion record for this file: mod authorship is not evidenced, so it is unclear and excluded
codes.S-SUBMESH: sub-mesh names carry a base-game family (norwegian_ski_troops / ottoman_commodore): the geometry is derived from a base-game mesh
codes.S-FILENAME: file name in a base-game family (euro_, episodic_, officer3/general3 ...)
codes.S-PATH: path names a base-game part family (unitparts/euro, cossack, hungarian, english heads)
codes.S-TEXREF: the model references base-game texture names (field_carriage_*, euro_cannon_barrel_*); derivation from a base-game carriage cannot be ruled out
codes.S-IDENTICAL: byte-identical to a file in the base-game namespace (unitparts/euro): a copy, not new work
codes.S-LODCOPY: all LOD files are byte-identical copies of one file: a copy, not four authored LODs
codes.PAIRED-STOCK-MESH: texture atlas is the UV sheet of a base-game-derived mesh and carries base-game face photographs (viewed)
codes.PLACEHOLDER: tool placeholder image (identical in many places; a light-bulb icon), not artwork
codes.DECODE-UNVERIFIED: this tool does not decode/verify this file type well enough to place or render it (gap EG-FIG-0012)
codes.ATLAS-MIXED: baked atlas that mixes garment cells with base-game face cells; per-cell authorship unknown
codes.ANACHRONISM: viewed in the decoder self-test: a modern fictional character (school-uniform figure), not a soldier of 1863; it is also not referenced by any mod table
codes.OUT-OF-SCOPE: not a figure, officer, flag, gun or horse asset (terrain, building, fence, UI, audio, data)
codes.NOT-ART: not an art asset (tool housekeeping or data)
codes.INCLUDED: all of E1, E2, E3 hold
